user.title: SolarSplit
user.description: Choose the grid sensors and the global settings of the surplus control loop.

data_description.export_sensor: Power exported to the grid, in W. Main signal of the loop.
data_description.import_sensor: Power imported from the grid, in W. Used to detect a deficit.
data_description.pv_sensor: PV production, in W. Needed for zero-injection mode.
data_description.zero_injection_entity: When this entity is on, the inverter limits export and the loop probes loads instead.
data_description.global_condition: When this entity is off, the loop leaves every load as it is.
data_description.cycle_interval: How often the control loop runs.
data_description.safety_margin: Power never handed out to loads.
data_description.smoothing_window: Moving average applied to the readings to filter clouds and spikes.
data_description.settle_time: Wait after a change before the next one.
data_description.on_margin: Extra power a load needs, above its own, to be switched on.
data_description.import_tolerance: Grid import tolerated before a load is switched off.
